title: Spray 水下滑翔機
summary: 以Spray長期海洋剖面資料為案例，聚焦時間取樣與季節變化，避免把不同日期的斷面直接當成同時的空間場。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Spray long-term profile data to focus on temporal sampling and seasonal variability, avoiding interpretation of sections from different dates as one simultaneous spatial field. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 分開浮力引擎與電子負載能量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate buoyancy-engine and electronics energy: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 分開浮力引擎與電子負載能量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate buoyancy-engine and electronics energy and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分開浮力引擎與電子負載能量：將流體體積推向外部壓差需要pΔV做功；理想液壓做功與電池耗能不同。 本步以「浮力引擎理想做功」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Separate buoyancy-engine and electronics energy: Pushing fluid volume against pressure requires pΔV work; ideal hydraulic work differs from battery energy. Use Ideal buoyancy-engine work to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Spray 水下滑翔機實際規格：壓差p=2.2 MPa、體積變化ΔV=0.0001 m³。式 W=pΔV，基準結果 220 J。條件：壓差固定的理想積分；實際效率、密封摩擦與壓力變動不在內，不提供製造或加壓操作。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Spray underwater glider: Pressure difference p=2.2 MPa, volume change ΔV=0.0001 m³. Formula W=pΔV gives 220 J. Conditions: Ideal fixed-pressure integral excluding efficiency, seal friction and changing pressure; no fabrication or pressure operation provided.
steps.failure: 把表壓、絕對壓與泵兩端壓差混用會算錯功；先定義系統兩端。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Mixing gauge, absolute and across-pump pressure gives wrong work; define both system endpoints. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 在壓力-體積圖標出矩形面積，另列電源耗能，確認電能不小於理想液壓功。 本案例另須檢查「分開浮力引擎與電子負載能量」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Shade the rectangle on a pressure-volume plot and list source energy separately; electrical energy should not be below ideal hydraulic work. Also check that Separate buoyancy-engine and electronics energy and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：分開浮力引擎與電子負載能量。在長期剖面時間線、滑翔示意、漂移與品質旗標圖完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加壓差10%，保持體積變化，重算理想功並討論效率損失。 算式區的基準值為220，改變後為242 J。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate buoyancy-engine and electronics energy. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Long-term profile timeline, glide schematic, drift and quality-flag charts. Increase pressure difference alone by 10%, retain volume change and discuss efficiency losses. Baseline 220 changes to 242 J. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Separate buoyancy-engine and electronics energy: Pushing fluid volume against pressure requires pΔV work; ideal hydraulic work differs from battery energy. Shade the rectangle on a pressure-volume plot and list source energy separately; electrical energy should not be below ideal hydraulic work. steps.instruction: 把海流帶來的水平位移當成滑翔效率提升會誤判；需估計水體參考系。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting current-induced travel as improved gliding efficiency is misleading; estimate the water reference frame. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Spray 水下滑翔機實際規格：垂向落差h=220 m、假設水平/垂向比3。式 x=Gh，基準結果 660 m。條件：固定滑翔比，不含轉向、浮力引擎耗能和海流；非載具航跡指令。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Spray underwater glider: Vertical change h=220 m, assumed horizontal/vertical ratio 3. Formula x=Gh gives 660 m. Conditions: Fixed glide ratio without turns, buoyancy-engine energy or current; not a vehicle route instruction.
steps.failure: 把海流帶來的水平位移當成滑翔效率提升會誤判；需估計水體參考系。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Interpreting current-induced travel as improved gliding efficiency is misleading; estimate the water reference frame. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 將下潛與上浮兩段畫在剖面圖，分別標記對水幾何路程和海流位移。 本案例另須檢查「比較同深度不同滑翔比的空間覆蓋」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Draw descent and ascent on a section and label through-water geometric travel separately from current displacement. Also check that Compare coverage at equal depth and different glide ratios and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 比較同深度不同滑翔比的空間覆蓋
knowledge.titleEn: Compare coverage at equal depth and different glide ratios
knowledge.text: 把海流帶來的水平位移當成滑翔效率提升會誤判；需估計水體參考系。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
knowledge.textEn: Interpreting current-induced travel as improved gliding efficiency is misleading; estimate the water reference frame. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：比較同深度不同滑翔比的空間覆蓋。在長期剖面時間線、滑翔示意、漂移與品質旗標圖完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加垂向落差10%，保持假設滑翔比，重算水平幾何路程。 算式區的基準值為660，改變後為726 m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Compare coverage at equal depth and different glide ratios. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Long-term profile timeline, glide schematic, drift and quality-flag charts. Increase vertical change alone by 10%, retain glide ratio and recalculate geometric horizontal travel. Baseline 660 changes to 726 m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
